name: Scanline Interleaving
definition: An image partitioning strategy that assigns successive scanlines to processors in round-robin fashion to evenly distribute pixel-oriented ray-merging computations, addressing variations in depth complexity caused by local variations in cell sizes.
summary: Scanline Interleaving distributes image rows cyclically across processors to balance ray-merging loads, differing from cell-based or dynamic methods by operating on the image plane with static assignment.
